He hears about an upcoming dance and, wanting to go with someone he trusted, begged Eren to pair up with him. Only after he insists that he is not good at social situations does Eren finally relent. He later defuses a brewing situation between Mikasa and Annie, not realizing they both had plans to invite Eren to the same dance event. Armin later helps take part in the contest between the first year students and the upperclassmen. He tries to come up with plans to help Eren lead them to a victory; ultimately though, the first years lose and are forced to attend the dance with the Titan students. During the summer months, Armin returns to the school with the others to help Levi in cleaning. Levi notices Armin still wearing his blanket and orders him to remove it. Armin does not want to comply and tries to explain that the heat does not affect him. This does not work and Armin is prompted by Eren to reveal that he does not feel like himself without it. After hearing Levi continue to insist he remove it, Armin sees no other solution and begrudgingly agrees. However, Armin ultimately finds he cannot do it and Eren urges him to run away. Armin does so, causing Levi to swear he will remove it by any means necessary. Levi manages to trick Armin into leaving his futon unattended and steals it from his balcony. Armin immediately calls Eren, who arrives with Mikasa, Jean, Sasha and Connie. Already beginning to show the symptoms of a cold from not having his futon, Armin informs them that his room was much cleaner than it was before his futon went missing and believes Levi to be responsible for the theft; he begs them to find Levi and steal his futon back. He goes with them to the student dormitories where Levi is staying and is caught by surprise by the traps seemingly laid out by him. Initially viewing it as hopeless, Armin suddenly has a change in heart and rallies the others forward. One by one, they all fall victim to numerous traps around the dormitory until only Armin is left to confront Levi. Bursting through the door, Armin sees Levi holding both his futon and a long needle; this causes Armin to let out a shriek and lunge towards Levi to grab his futon back. After Eren and Mikasa both arrive, they find Armin happily curled up underneath his futon. After Levi explains that there was a hole in it and he merely took Armin's futon to sew it up, Armin apologizes and says that Levi is a great person after all. During the Culture Festival, Armin decides to join Eren's band to compete in the 'Battle of the Bands' competition as a bass guitar player. As the group decides on what to do with the performance, Armin suggests they go into a hard rock/metal direction and end their performance by smashing Jean's guitar and set it on fire to pump up the excitement of the audience; the idea is swiftly rejected by Mikasa in particular. During the Battle of the Bands, Armin's group wins over the audience but ultimately falls to the prior year's winners: The No-Name Band, comprised of Hange, Levi and Mike.

Armin Arlert (Lost Girls) is the best friend of Eren Yeager and a member of the 104th Training Corps. In Mikasa's dream, he appeared as a young boy who attempts to escape the Walls using an airplane that he and Eren made. Appearance. Armin has a round face, blond hair that is cut in the style of a bob cut. He wears the standard 104th Training Corps uniform. In Mikasa's dream, he is shown as a small boy wearing a light-button-up shirt and long light pants. Personality. Armin cares deeply for his friends, crying over their deaths. Armin dreamed of traveling the world beyond the walls. In Mikasa's dream, he enjoys making and working on different things such as a butterfly container and a prototype airplane his parents made. He is a foolish boy, believing that he was able to make a working airplane. After Eren's death, he faults himself for telling Eren about the outside world. Story. Lost in the Cruel World arc. In Trost District, Armin cries in the rain as he reports the deaths of his squad to Mikasa Ackerman. In Mikasa's dream, Armin spends many days playing with Eren Yeager from day to night. The two boys bonded over their desire to travel outside the Walls. Armin told Eren about his parents' death. His parents had tried to build an airplane to go outside the Walls but failed and died. Armin showed Eren a prototype airplane that his parents had worked on. Together the two made improvements to the airplane. They soon completed the airplane and decided to fly over the Walls at night. During the time that they worked on the airplane, Armin gifted Eren a butterfly container that he had made. On the night of their planned trip, Armin runs in the rain to deliver a message to Mikasa. He falls to the ground as he tells her about Eren's death. He tells her it is his fault for telling Eren about the outside world, and says the airplane failed to take off and that Eren saved him by pushing him out of the plane before crashing into the Wall. Armin starts to apologize to Mikasa.

Armin Arlert (Spoof on Titan) is a secondary protagonist of the "Spoof on Titan" manga. He is a Survey Corps soldier and former member of the 104th Training Corps. Appearance. Armin has large eyes with medium length hair that has bangs straight across. He wears a 104th Training Corps uniform then later Survey Corps.

Armored Titan The was one of the Nine Titans that possessed armored plates of skin across its body. Abilities. Armored skin. The defining feature of the Armored Titan was the all-encompassing layer of plated, armor-like segments of hardened skin protecting the Titan body. This armor was capable of shielding the Titan from significant amounts of damage, shielding direct hit from a cannon, breaking ultrahard steel blades of vertical maneuvering equipment when struck and withstanding the Colossus Titan's explosive transformation. However, the armor had some limitations and was not capable of protecting the user from high-power weaponry such as the Mid-East Allied Forces' anti-Titan artillery. The armor could be used for physical protection as well as offensively, dealing great damage upon impact on anything the Titan charges. While certainly formidable, the primary disadvantage of the Armored Titan's skin was the decreased speed of the Titan form. Whether due to increased weight or restrained movement, the Armored Titan was only capable of maintaining moderate running speeds when completely armored. This could be alleviated if the user chose to shed segments of the armor to increase movement capability, such as the armor behind the knees, enabling the Titan to move with incredible speed. A lesser-known disadvantage was that if the holder of the Founding Titan wished to, they were able to cause the hardened skin of the Armored Titan to crumble away to nothing; this left the Titan prone and extremely vulnerable to damage.However, this only seemed to apply to the current body created by transforming, as transforming into the Armored Titan later revealed it to be restored of its namesake armor. Hardening. Similar to the Female Titan, the Armored Titan was capable of utilizing crystal-like hardening around its body to at least some extent. The Armored Titan could also use this ability to create claws on its hands and feet which could be used to scale the Wall of Shiganshina District with ease. History. The Armored Titan, like all the Nine Titans, was brought into the world after the death of Ymir Fritz. In the 1,700 years following her death, the Armored Titan was held in the possession of one or several of the warring Eldian houses subservient to the Founding Titan. After these seventeen centuries when Karl Fritz, the 145th King of the Fritz family, abandoned the conflicts of Eldia and relocated to Paradis Island, the Armored Titan was taken by the nation of Marley during the Great Titan War. In the year 843, Reiner Braun was chosen to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He would later make use of his Titan form in a war between Marley and an enemy nation, using his Armored Titan to take the brunt of enemy artillery fire. In the year 845, the nation of Marley sent out Reiner, Bertolt Hoover, Annie Leonhart, and Marcel Galliard across the ocean to Paradis Island as the start of the Paradis Island Operation. Story. Prologue arc. After arriving on the island and venturing northwards to the Walls, Reiner entered Shiganshina District, the southernmost district of the Walls, after Bertolt destroyed the south gate with his Colossus Titan. As panicked Eldians fled the city while Titans swarmed in, Reiner's Armored Titan advanced to the north gate and charged it, breaking through and breaching the northern part of Wall Maria. Reiner joined his fellow surviving Warriors in entering the walled territory during the chaos, and he would not use the Armored Titan again for another five years. Battle of Trost District arc. Five years after the fall of Wall Maria, the Warriors of Marley learn of Eren Yeager's unknowing possession of the Attack Titan. Believing that he may also be the current inheritor of the Founding Titan that they are searching for, Reiner does not use his Armored Titan to breach Wall Rose's northern gate after Bertolt Hoover breaches the southern gate of Trost District with his Colossus Titan as initially planned; instead, the Warriors turn their full attention towards Eren. Clash of the Titans arc. Over a month later, Reiner reaches a breaking point and chooses to reveal his nature as the Armored Titan as well as Bertolt's nature as the Colossus Titan to Eren, promising to leave the people of the Walls alone if he returns with them to their hometown. When Eren refuses and Mikasa attacks the two Warriors, Reiner transforms into the Armored Titan and grabs Eren. However, Eren in turn transforms into the Attack Titan and battles with Reiner. Despite improvements to Eren's control over the Attack Titan, Reiner's Armored Titan overpowers him initially until Eren makes use of a technique that was taught to him by Annie Leonhart some time ago, taking one of Reiner's arms before retreating temporarily. Requiring more speed, Reiner begins shedding the armor behind his knees and continues his attack on Eren, but he is nonetheless overpowered by the Attack Titan again. With defeat imminent, Reiner calls for Bertolt's Colossus Titan, which falls on the two Titans in an explosive burst of steam. Reiner is able to withstand the intense winds and bites Eren out of his Attack Titan. Once Bertolt exits his Titan with a captive Ymir, the two Warriors escape to the nearby Titan Forest. After some conversation in the forest, the Warriors start their retreat upon seeing signal flares from the Survey Corps. Reiner uses his Armored Titan to carry Bertolt and their captives away, and the Survey Corps pursues them. Their retreat goes unhindered until Commander Erwin Smith charges the Reiner's Armored Titan head-on with a horde of Pure Titans following after him. Reiner attempts to fight back against the Titans, and the Warriors lose Eren to the Survey Corps in the moment of vulnerability. Shortly afterward, Eren succeeds in temporarily using the Founding Titan, causing the Titans to swarm after the Warriors. Reiner flees with Bertolt and Ymir, and they rest in the ruins of Shiganshina District. Royal Government arc. Some time later, Reiner's Armored Titan battles Zeke Yeager's Beast Titan due to having disagreements over their next course of action. Reiner is soundly defeated in the brawl, and Zeke states that they will wait in Shiganshina for the arrival of the Survey Corps rather than attempting to rescue Annie. Return to Shiganshina arc. Three months after the battle of Trost District, the Survey Corps arrive in Shiganshina and seal the southern gate using a new hardening ability acquired by Eren's Attack Titan. Suspecting that the Warriors may be nearby, Armin Arlert proposes a search of the Wall and Reiner is found hiding within. As he is attacked by Captain Levi, Reiner uses one of his last-resort Titan powers to transfer his brain functions to the entirety of his body long enough for him to transform into the Armored Titan. As the battle of Shiganshina District begins, Reiner hardens his fingers to climb Wall Maria in order to attack the Survey Corps' horses. However, Eren's Attack Titan appears in the city and Reiner is left with a choice of attack. Reiner chooses to confront Eren, and the Attack Titan battles with the Armored Titan for a second time. Eren's new ability to harden the Attack Titan's skin successfully deals heavy damage to Reiner's Armored Titan, but the greatest damage done is dealt from the Thunder Spears, a new explosive weapon developed by the Survey Corps in recent months. The explosives tear through the armor of Reiner's nape and destroy his brain, though his consciousness transfer once again keeps him alive. Reiner then roars for help as planned and shortly thereafter Bertolt arrives at Reiner's side, telling him to lie down on his back for the time being. While Bertolt confronts the Survey Corps, Reiner follows Bertolt's advice and flips his Armored Titan onto its back, protecting Reiner from further harm and giving him enough time to regenerate his head. A short while later, Reiner fully heals his brain and he returns to the fight, but with no memory of any events that had occurred since earlier that morning. The Survey Corps attacks Reiner with the Thunder Spears again, incapacitating him and successfully ejecting Reiner from the nape of his Armored Titan. Reiner is interrogated afterward, but before he can be killed, he is rescued by Zeke and Pieck's Cart Titan, who brings him atop Wall Maria. The Warriors would return to Marley afterward, abandoning Annie and Bertolt. Marley arc. Four years later, Reiner is present at the battle of Fort Slava at the climax of the Marley Mid-East War, waiting on standby in an airship due to the presence of anti-Titan artillery on the ground below. Once the ground infantry succeed in destroying the armored train carrying the artillery around the fortress, Reiner eventually joins the combat as the Armored Titan after a Titan airstrike sent down with the power of Zeke's Beast Titan. Alongside Porco Galliard's Jaw Titan, Reiner's Armored Titan decimates the anti-Titan artillery set up on the walls of the fortress. When the coast is clear, Reiner signals for the Zeke to join the battle, where his Beast Titan throws spare artillery at the Mid-East Allied Forces' navy stationed in the bay nearby. However, when the ships begin to open fire on Zeke's Beast Titan, Reiner uses his Armored Titan as a shield for Zeke, receiving devastating damage in the process. Despite having lost his entire body below the head in the explosion, Reiner later recovered. One month later during Willy Tybur's speech in Liberio, Falco Grice takes Reiner to a basement behind the stage, where he meets Eren Yeager for the first time in four years. After Eren sets aside their differences and clarifies that Reiner is not his true enemy, he takes Reiner's hand and begins to transform. In a state of panic, Reiner bites his hand to transform and protect Falco. He creates two armored hands that successfully shield the two of them from the energy blast and resulting wreckage. Reiner is unconscious following the attack and his injuries do not regenerate. Falco suspects this is due to Reiner having lost the will to live. As the Survey Corps and Warriors battle in Liberio, Falco and Gabi Braun cry out for Reiner to save Galliard's Jaw Titan, which is about to be eaten by Eren's Attack Titan. Reiner reluctantly wakes up and transforms into an incomplete Armored Titan, which is missing much of its namesake armor. Reiner is able to free Galliard from Eren's grip, but is unable to stand again after Eren punches him across the plaza. War for Paradis arc. The Armored Titan returns to Shiganshina as part of Marley's retaliatory strike against Paradis Island. Having transformed in midair to fight Eren's Titan, the two Titans are quick to clash once again. The Armored Titan is aggressive in its attack, though is somewhat overpowered by Eren's hardened punches. Soon, the Jaw Titan comes to assist Reiner, and helped from afar by the Cart Titan's projectiles, the tide of battle is turned. The three Warriors force Eren to overexert himself by using the War Hammer Titan's construction powers to keep the Jaw and Armored Titans at bay. Eventually, the Armored Titan uses a hardened pike it had been impaled on to skewer the Attack Titan, before attempting to devour Eren. However, Reiner is stopped as Eren manages to get a hold of his Titan's head and hold him off. As the two begin a struggle, the Armored Titan is knocked off of his adversary by a projectile thrown by the Beast Titan. The Armored Titan is caught in a daze but eventually recovers and targets the Attack Titan once more. However, it is caught in a barrage of projectiles thrown by the Beast Titan, tearing it apart. After recovering, the Armored Titan resumes fighting Eren and attempts to rouse Galliard within the mangled Jaw Titan. Soon after, Zeke lets out a scream that transforms all the affected Eldians into Pure Titans; immediately, the Armored Titan is set upon by the newly transformed Falco Grice. Caught by surprise, the Armored Titan struggles to control both the Attack Titan and Falco. After the Beast Titan is shot by General Magath a second time, Reiner believes that Zeke is finally dead and as such, loosens the armor around the nape of the Armored Titan. However, the transformed Falco ceases in biting the nape and instead targets a nearby Galliard, who is unable to sufficiently heal his wounds. The Armored Titan soon finds itself trapped in the hardened shell of the Attack Titan; breaking free, it tries to crush Eren but its hand gets struck and blown apart by a Thunder Spear. Following the start of the Rumbling, the Armored Titan reaches Gabi and shields her from the falling debris. The Titan's armor also crumbles away however, forcing Reiner to abandon his Titan form. After Reiner regains consciousness, he joins the combined group of the Survey Corps and Warriors who go down to the harbor to attack the Yeagerists and take the flying boat. After their initial plan fails, Reiner and Annie Leonhart transform into their Titan forms and engage the incoming enemies. Both Titans saw initial success as they repelled the Yeagerists attacks from the Thunder Spears and gunshots from the anti-personnel vertical maneuvering equipment, however, when the Azumabito engineers enter the battlefield trying to make it to the boat, Reiner is forced to use his Titan's body to protect them leading to his nape being exposed after various Thunder Spears are fired. Later, when the Female Titan is in trouble, the Armored Titan uses his face to block them and takes the impact causing his facial armor to be destroyed followed by the rest of his face and his arms being destroyed. Just before he is finished off, Connie Springer kills the incoming Yeagerists which then allowed Pieck's Cart Titan and Falco's Jaw Titan to dismember the enemies. After arriving to Fort Salta, Reiner jumps out of the flying boat and transforms mid-air into the Armored Titan to engage the Beast Titan that is throwing projectiles towards the flying boat. The Armored Titan successfully puts a stop to the Beast Titan and engages it through hand to hand combat. The Titan forms of previous inheritors begin to spawn from the back of the Founder Titan and the Armored Titan eventually gets overwhelmed; Reiner notices with surprise when several Titans begin fighting the others, including both Galliard brothers and Ymir's Jaw Titans. When Jean is able to detonate the explosives located at the neck of the Founding Titan, the Armored Titan lunges towards the creature emerging from the neck and tackles it to the ground, trying to prevent it from reconnecting with the severed head. Having withstood the Colossus Titan explosion that destroyed the remains of the Founding Titan, Reiner heads towards the creature which also survived the blast. The anomaly then emits a gas, transforming all nearby Eldians into Pure Titans. Reiner tries to fight them off but is overwhelmed shortly before the power of Titans vanishes, and the Armored Titan does so as well.

Armored Titan (Anime) The was one of the Nine Titans that possessed armored plates of skin across its body. Abilities. Armored skin. The defining feature of the Armored Titan was the all-encompassing layer of plated, armor-like segments of hardened skin protecting the Titan body. This armor was capable of shielding the Titan from significant amounts of damage, shielding direct hit from a cannon, breaking ultrahard steel blades of ODM gear when struck and withstanding the Colossal Titan's explosive transformation. However, the armor had some limitations and was not capable of protecting the user from high-power weaponry such as the Mid-East Allied Forces' anti-Titan artillery. The armor could be used for physical protection as well as offensively, dealing great damage upon impact on anything the Titan charges. While certainly formidable, the primary disadvantage of the Armored Titan's skin was the decreased speed of the Titan form. Whether due to increased weight or restrained movement, the Armored Titan was only capable of maintaining moderate running speeds when completely armored. This could be alleviated if the user chose to shed segments of the armor to increase movement capability, such as the armor behind the knees, enabling the Titan to move with incredible speed. A lesser-known disadvantage was that if the holder of the Founding Titan wished to, they were able to cause the hardened skin of the Armored Titan to crumble away to nothing; this left the Titan prone and extremely vulnerable to damage. However, this only seemed to apply to the current body created by transforming, as transforming into the Armored Titan later revealed it to be restored of its namesake armor. Hardening. Similar to the Female Titan, the Armored Titan was capable of utilizing crystal-like hardening around its body to at least some extent. The Armored Titan could also use this ability to create claws on its hands and feet which could be used to scale the Wall of Shiganshina District with ease. History. The Armored Titan, like all the Nine Titans, was brought into the world after the death of Ymir Fritz. In the 1,700 years following her death, the Armored Titan was held in the possession of one or several of the warring Eldian houses subservient to the Founding Titan. After these seventeen centuries when Karl Fritz, the 145th King of the Fritz family, abandoned the conflicts of Eldia and relocated to Paradis Island, the Armored Titan was taken by the nation of Marley during the Great Titan War. In the year 843, Reiner Braun was chosen to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He would later make use of his Titan form in a war between Marley and an enemy nation, using his Armored Titan to take the brunt of enemy artillery fire. Artur Blouse is the father of Sasha Blouse, husband of Lisa Blouse, and a hunter in Dauper village. It was his words that motivated Sasha to leave and join the Military. Appearance. Artur Blouse is a large but not overweight man. He has shaggy brown hair, a thin goatee, and brown eyes. He is usually seen wearing a striped hat, a white t-shirt with a fur vest, and a loose tie. He also wears white pants, tall black boots, and carries a pack of arrows on his back along with a small supplies bag on his right hip. In 854, he looks thinner and has a lighter goatee and mustache. Personality. Blouse appears to be a man of rules, and devoted to his clan. He is a mature father figure, storing food for the winter and attempting to pry it out of his daughter Sasha's hands when she begins to eat their supply. Though he appreciates his way of life, hunting with the clan, he realizes that many people's homes were taken by Titans and that they must share the forest. He is very wise, stating that though he would rather not, he may give up hunting and breed horses or sell crop for the good of everyone. Like his daughter, he has a native Dauper accent. Blouse is a very selfless man, and is constantly seen putting others before himself. He has no qualms about allowing refugees from Wall Maria to hunt on his land, despite the fact that it leaves less food for his family, as he recognizes the dire situation that they have been forced into by losing their homes. Additionally, he and his wife decide to open their home up to orphaned children going so far as to refer to them as his "family." Perhaps the greatest example of this selfless attitude, though, is his decision to forgive Gabi Braun for murdering his daughter. Rather than blame her for shooting Sasha, he chooses to accept the blame himself for allowing Sasha to leave Dauper and join the military, and chooses to spare Gabi's life so that the cycle of violence that led to Sasha's death might stop in some small way. Story. Prologue arc. Blouse is first seen arguing with Sasha, telling her not to eat the meat from the winter from the ground. After he fails, he explains to his daughter the reason why it is important to keep the food: after the fall of Wall Maria, many refugees have come to Wall Rose's lands, which has resulted in a food shortage due to the extra mouths to feed. In particular, refugees have begun hunting for food in Dauper's territory, leaving less game for the village's citizens than usual. Blouse admits to having considered giving the forest to them so that they can make fields, while the hunter's tribe starts taking care of horses, but Sasha objects, arguing that they should not stop living like they do just because of the newcomers. Blouse acknowledges his daughter's point, but he disagrees with her, saying that it is more important to take care of the people, rather than live all alone. He finally states that he wants to live with his clan, even if it means to change their way of life. Sasha, angered, enlists in the Military in retaliation. Clash of the Titans arc. Three years later, Sasha comes to her village, only to find it ravaged by Titans. After helping one little girl to escape from one of them, she sees her father riding a horse. He sees her too, seeming very surprised and screaming her name. He gives a horse to her and the girl she had saved, Kaya. They start talking, and Blouse explains that they have been giving horses to the nearby people. He also expresses how surprised he is to see that the person that saved Kaya was Sasha. He finally states that she has become a splendid person, making her smile and accept her home. War for Paradis arc. In the year 854, Artur and his family visit Sasha's grave. As they are paying their respects, a Marleyan prisoner of war introduces himself to the family. He tells them that Sasha ate his meals the most and offers to cook for them someday. After returning to their home, Kaya goes for a walk and returns with two children who she found in the woods. Artur welcomes them to the Blouse stables and allows them to say for however long they need. Artur takes his entire family, including Ben and Mia, to Niccolo's restaurant with him. They all enjoy the food, with Blouse and his wife being moved to tears by the taste. In the middle of eating, Ben and Mia leave, claiming that Ben has a stomach ache. Blouse and his family continue eating, but they are interrupted when Niccolo emerges from the wine cellar, holding an unconscious Ben and tossing a bloodied Mia to them. Blouse is bewildered by Niccolo's behavior, and is shocked to learn that Mia is the one who was responsible for killing Sasha. Niccolo offers him a knife to execute her, claiming that he will do it himself if Blouse refuses. Blouse takes the knife from Niccolo, but instead of killing Mia, explains how he was responsible for sending Sasha away from their village into a bigger "forest", choosing to let go of his pain and hatred in an attempt to help the children escape from this forest. As Niccolo is restrained by members of the Survey Corps, Blouse and his wife tend to Ben's injuries with Hange Zoë. As he goes to check on Mia as well, Kaya tries to kill her with Niccolo's knife, and Blouse is forced to restrain her with his wife to keep Mia safe. Artur is present when Niccolo reveals that the restaurant's wine is likely infused with Zeke's spinal fluid. Niccolo seeks solace in Artur, telling him that he is not capable of being a man like him yet. Blouse also expresses his worry for Ben, who had likely ingested the wine. Later, Blouse and his family are shocked by the Yeagerists entrance into the restaurant, and are later taken as captives by the group. The Blouses are imprisoned with the Survey Corps officers together in Shiganshina military headquarters, where Blouse keeps himself busy by making tea for everyone with Niccolo. The Marleyan forces arrive at Shiganshina and launch their surprise attack on Paradis. While Eren Yeager engages with the Jaw Titan and as the fight on the rooftop ensues, Artur and the other prisoners wonder what the sound overhead them was about. Onyankopon releases the prisoners from their cell and Jean orders Niccolo to keep the Blouse family safe. Niccolo escorts the Blouse family through Shiganshina, leading them to a house in a relatively safe section where they can stay until the fighting is over. Although his wife is worried about Gabi and Falco, Artur assures her that the two will be fine, saying they are both strong. The family takes refuge in an abandoned building, but are forced to flee when they are found by a Pure Titan. Kaya trips and gets separated from the group, and Niccolo saves Artur from being devoured while trying to save her. Kaya is saved by the timely arrival of Gabi, who explains that she has returned to rescue Falco. The group is found by a group of soldiers who agree to escort them to the safety of the military's headquarters, but Artur encourages Gabi to leave and save Falco the first chance that she gets. After arriving at the military headquarters, Artur meets Armin and Mikasa and brings them to Gabi so that she can ask them to return Falco to her.

Though he appreciates his way of life, hunting with the clan, he realizes that many people's homes were taken by Titans and that they must share the forest for the greater good. He appears to be very wise, willing to accept change and move beyond their traditions if it meant a better way of life for everyone. Like his daughter, he has a native Dauper accent. Artur is a very selfless man, and is constantly seen putting others before himself. He has no qualms about allowing refugees from Wall Maria to hunt on his land, despite the fact that it leaves less food for his family, as he recognizes the dire situation that they have been forced into by losing their homes. Additionally, he and his wife decide to open their home up to orphaned children going so far as to refer to them as his "family." Perhaps the greatest example of this selfless attitude, though, is his decision to forgive Gabi Braun for murdering his daughter. Rather than blame her for shooting Sasha, he chooses to accept the blame himself for allowing Sasha to leave Dauper and join the military, and chooses to spare Gabi's life so that the cycle of violence that led to Sasha's death might stop in some small way. Story. The Fall of Shiganshina arc. Artur is first seen arguing with Sasha, telling her not to eat the meat from the winter from the ground. After he fails, he explains to his daughter the reason why it is important to keep the food: after the fall of Wall Maria, many refugees have come to Wall Rose's lands, which has resulted in a food shortage due to the extra mouths to feed. In particular, refugees have begun hunting for food in Dauper's territory, leaving less game for the village's citizens than usual. Artur admits to having considered giving the forest to them so that they can make fields, while the hunter's tribe starts taking care of horses, but Sasha objects, arguing that they should not stop living like they do just because of the newcomers, stating that the newcomers always looked down on their village and it was not fair for them to come and take from the people they criticized. Artur acknowledges his daughter's point, but he disagrees with her, saying that it is more important to take care of the people and accept change instead of living all alone. He finally states that he wants to live with his clan, even if it means to change their way of life. Sasha, angered, enlists in the Military in retaliation. Clash of the Titans arc. Three years later, Sasha comes to her village, only to find it ravaged by Titans. After helping one little girl to escape from one of them, she sees her father riding a horse. He sees her too, seeming very surprised and screaming her name. He gives her and the kid that she had saved a horse. They start talking, and Artur explains that they have been giving horses to the nearby people. He also expresses how surprised he is to see that the person that saved the child was Sasha. He finally states that she has become a splendid person, making her smile and accept her home. Marley arc. In the year 854, Artur and his family visit Sasha's grave. As they are paying their respects, a Marleyan prisoner of war introduces himself to the family. He tells them that Sasha ate his meals the most and offers to cook for them someday. War for Paradis arc. After returning to their home, Kaya goes for a walk and returns with two children who she found in the woods. Artur welcomes them to the Braus Stables and allows them to say for however long they need. Artur takes his entire family, including Ben and Mia, to Nicolo's restaurant. They all enjoy the food, with Artur and his wife being moved to tears by the taste. In the middle of eating Ben and Mia leave, claiming that Ben has a stomach ache. Artur and his family continue eating, but are interrupted when Nicolo emerges from the wine cellar with them, holding an unconscious Ben and tossing a bloodied Mia to them. Artur is bewildered by Nicolo's behavior, and is shocked to learn that Mia is the one who was responsible for killing Sasha. Nicolo offers him a knife to execute her, claiming that he will do it himself if Artur refuses. Artur takes the knife from Nicolo, but instead of killing Gabi, explains how he was responsible for sending Sasha away from their village into a bigger "forest", choosing to let go of his pain and hatred in an attempt to help the children escape from this forest. As Nicolo is restrained by the Scouts, Artur and his wife tend to Ben's injuries with Hange Zoë. As he goes to check on Mia as well, Kaya tries to kill her with Nicolo's knife, and Artur is forced to restrain her with his wife to keep Mia safe. The Brauses are imprisoned with the Scouts together in Shiganshina military headquarters, where Artur keeps himself busy by making tea for everyone with Nicolo. Onyankopon releases the prisoners from their cell and Jean orders Nicolo to keep the Braus family safe. Nicolo escorts the Braus family through Shiganshina, leading them to a house in a relatively safe section where they can stay until the fighting is over. Although his wife is worried about Gabi and Falco, Artur assures her that the two will be fine, saying they are both strong. The family takes refuge in an abandoned building, but are forced to flee when they are found by a Pure Titan. Kaya trips and gets separated from the group, and Nicolo saves Artur from being devoured while trying to save her. Kaya is saved by the timely arrival of Gabi, who explains that she has returned to rescue Falco. The group is found by a group of soldiers who agree to escort them to the safety of the military's headquarters, but Artur encourages Gabi to leave and save Falco the first chance that she gets. After arriving at the military headquarters, Artur meets Armin and Mikasa and brings them to Gabi so that she can ask them to return Falco to her.
